messages:
Ravi T.: Quick thread to finalize abstracts, A/B test plan, and production run-of-show for the webinar (Reducing inference cost without losing quality). We need final copy for the registration page, whos speaking, and a crisp fallback play.

Maya L.: I drafted two abstracts: A) "Real-world levers to cut per-token spend" (practical, buttoned-up) B) "How to squeeze cost out of LLM serving (without breaking your app)" (edgier). Recommend A for enterprise audience, B for dev-first channels. Thoughts?

Paolo (prod): Both good. Suggest A for LinkedIn and B for dev newsletters. We should A/B the registration header to see which drives CTR. Can we get 2 variants live for 48h?

Hannah (ops): On production: I'm reserving a small Dedicated pool for the demo, will put hard autoscale caps. Ops fallback: prerecorded video + switch to rwd-7b-quant if errors spike. Also will pin a CDN-hosted cached response set for top 10 demo prompts.

Ethan A.: I'm the backup presenter if Paolo gets pulled into product ops. Also can riff on the cost playbook. For the demo, let's build a short script with 5 examples that show hallucination vs cost tradeoffs.

Ravi T.: Good. Registration copy needs two short bullets and a CTA. Maya, can you produce two 1-sentence bullets per abstract? Also need speaker bios (50 words).

Maya L.: Draft bullets: Variant A bullets: 1) "Practical batching and caching patterns that cut per-token cost by up to 3x" 2) "Tradeoffs between quantized models and output fidelity, with real metrics" Variant B bullets: 1) "Field-tested tricks to lower inference spend without retraining" 2) "Live demo: watch a 13B model vs a quantized 7B side-by-side". Bios: sending in DM to Ravi.

registrations-bot: Registration page created (draft): https://events.redwood.com/register/rl-cost-quality. A/B header flag: ab_test=webinar_header_v2.

Hannah (ops): AV + rehearsal checklist: mic + camera test 15m before, demo box on dedicated account, throttled network sim, local recording enabled, producer 1 on stream, producer 2 monitoring infra metrics. Rehearsal slots: Tue 09:30 PDT (full dress) and Wed 12:00 PDT (tech only).

Paolo (prod): Run-of-show suggestion (45 min total):
- 0:00-0:04 host intros (Ravi)
- 0:04-0:12 market context + why serving matters (Paolo)
- 0:12-0:20 cost playbook (Ethan)
- 0:20-0:30 demo (Ethan)
- 0:30-0:40 Q&A (all)
- 0:40-0:45 CTA & next steps (Ravi)

Maya L.: Can we swap demo to 0:16-0:26 so the playbook flows into it? People like seeing examples immediately after theory.

Paolo (prod): Swap accepted. Also, allocate 3 minutes at 0:28 for a quick poll asking "Which best describes your use case? (prototype, product, regulated)" to drive lead routing.

Ethan A.: For demo fallback automation: healthcheck script will poll demo endpoint and if 5xx > 3 within 20s or p95 latency > 1200ms in 30s then we: 1) route demo to rwd-7b-quant; 2) enable cached responses; 3) post message to private stage slack and to leadops channel. Also include an immediate stage prompt for the host: "Switching to recorded demo due to instability."

Hannah (ops): I'll upload recorded fallback to gs://redwood-assets/wbnr/cost-demo-v2.mp4 and set a public shortlink. Also will add a one-click toggle in the producer UI to swap demo route.

Ravi T.: Lead routing: attendees who pick "product" -> nurture drip with playbook PDF; "prototype" -> invite to quickstart sandbox; "regulated" -> route to AE + compliance pack. Ethan, can you prepare suggested copy snippets for each routing?

Ethan A.: Yep. I'll drop 3 email snippets and a 1-paragraph AE brief by EOD. Also propose we add an optional "request a bespoke consult" checkbox that triggers a priority AE flag.

Maya L.: Marketing promo plan: LinkedIn + Twitter + dev newsletter. Use Variant A on LinkedIn, Variant B in dev newsletter. We'll measure CTR to registration and qualification rate.

Paolo (prod): Small ask for speakers: keep demo commands visible in a separate window so ops can copy if needed. Also, include a short shell health-check we can run from stage to verify the demo route before show:

```bash
# quick healthcheck
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck/demo \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b-q4","prompt":"warmup"}'
```

Hannah (ops): Confirming rehearsal RSVPs: Ravi, Maya, Ethan, Paolo all confirmed for Tue 09:30 PDT. I'll send the private stage channel invite now.

Ravi T.: Outstanding action list:
- finalize registration bullets & two variant headers: Maya (due today)
- upload recorded fallback & shortlink: Hannah (due tomorrow)
- demo scripts + prompt set: Ethan (due today)
- producer UI toggle & healthcheck: Hannah (due EOD tomorrow)
- A/B header experiment live: registrations-bot (set by Maya)
- lead routing snippets & AE brief: Ethan (due EOD today)

Maya L.: I'll also prepare a 1-sentence social caption for each variant.

Ethan A.: Sending demo prompts DM now. One more ask: can we add a short slide at the end with "where to learn more" links (docs, quickstart, contact AE)? I'll draft.

Ravi T.: Great. After rehearsal we'll post the final run-of-show here and close the loop. Thanks all :rocket:
